turns: 12; I wrote `e2e/api/generated/LIF-08.spec.ts` with one test tagged `@LIF-08`. The API test passes, and `npx tsc --noEmit` printed no errors. No other file was changed.

The test arranges a vendor in review through `factory.vendorInReview`, using the existing `insurance_certificate_unparseable.txt` sample (expiry "next spring"). It then has the reviewer POST an approve decision and asserts a 409 with `insurance_expiry_missing`. Finally it re-reads the document's extraction and asserts it is still `pending_review`.

My first run failed because I passed the extraction ID to `factory.extraction`, which takes a document ID. The fix was to use `documents.insurance_certificate.id`.
